purpose: plan item 6: external VAD validation of the S1/S2 steering effects

lexicon.filter: single lowercase alphabetic words whose ' word' form is one Qwen token

readout: per-token mean over the 50 prompts of log(rank_baseline / rank_condition), R lens, final prompt token
statistic: Spearman r over lexicon tokens; partial r = Pearson r of rank residuals after regressing out the control ranks; 95% CI from 2000 bootstrap resamples of tokens, seed 20260925

predictions.P1_positive_valence: At R29, r(gain S2 -0.5, valence) > 0 and r(gain S1 -0.5, valence) > 0, both CIs above 0.
predictions.P2_arousal_late: Primary: partial r(gain S2 - gain S1, arousal | valence) at R29 exceeds the same at R16 (CI of the difference above 0) and is > 0 at R29 (CI above 0). Raw r reported alongside.
predictions.P3_dominance: Partial r(gain S2 -0.5 at R29, dominance | valence): CI includes 0 or lies below 0.

exploratory: direct-vector VAD correlations for -S2, -S1, -common, -contrast (raw and partial); all layers.
